text: The example property is an office building located at 12 Example Street in the fictional town of Riverton. The building has three above-ground floors and a total gross floor area of approximately 2,400 square metres. The main entrance faces Example Street.

A bus stop is located approximately 150 metres from the main entrance and is served by the fictional routes 4 and 7. The property can be reached by car via Example Street. Eight marked parking spaces are located behind the building.
The building includes a reception area, passenger lift, shared meeting room and bicycle storage. The sample source set does not contain an energy label or measured annual energy consumption.
